title: Laurel Pines Camp

services.name: Program Camp
services.desc: Summer Camp is designed to challenge, encourage and empower children. Each aspect of the week is designed to engage children in a new way; away from the busy, challenging life in the city. Summer camp sets the stage for engaging conversations, life-changing moments, fun-filled days and life time memories. Children participate in group conversations and adventurous activities, deep conversations and times of prayer and worship. Our program is designed to address every day and real issues that children face and teach them how to handle these issues in a real and meaningful way. They will discover relationships with new friends, mentors and their Creator and learn who they were created to be
